messages.subject: Error using the DWLS estimator
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to use a DWLS estimator to test a CFA model by declaring my variables as ''ordered'' in my fit specifications. Yet, I consistently get the following error and warning messages:

Error in t(Delta[[g]]) %*% lav...@WLS.V[[g]] : 
  non-conformable arguments
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In WLS.obs - WLS.est :
  longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length
2: In WLS.obs - WLS.est :
  longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length
3: In lavsamp...@WLS.obs[[g]] - WLS.est[[g]] :
  longer object length is not a multiple of shorter object length

As I am a relative newbie in R, I have no idea of the meaning of these messages. Could someone please enlighten me? Here is my R syntax, if that could be of help. I am testing a bifactor CFA model (items load on a general factor + on three uncorrelated subfactors) with a twin sample sample.This syntax includes various equality and non-equality constraints according to family (twin 1, twin 2) and zygosity group (MZ, DZ). The fit of the model is separately tested on both zygosity groups.
